description: Earth Shock Level 60 450 Mana 20 yd range Instant 6 sec cooldown Requires Shaman Requires level 60 Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 534 to 562 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
name: Earth Shock
